items.title: Warrant list
Minutes
Contracts and claims settlements list
Contract with Heavy Civil, Inc. for the construction of drainage improvements on A1A.
Contract with Florida Blacktop, Inc. for the construction of Palmetto Park Road & SR 7.
Agency for Health Care Administration Health Care Licensing Renewal Application to renew the Division of Senior and Veteran Services North County Adult Day Care Center license.
Ratify the Mayor's signature on Standard Agreement for the Older American Act.
Amendment No. 5 with the Area Agency on Aging of Palm Beach/Treasure Coast, Inc. to amend, revise and replace portions of the standard agreement and increase the overall total funding.
Amendments with Area Agency on Aging of Palm Beach/Treasure Coast, Inc., and with AAA to revise and replace portions of the standard agreements.
Ratify the Mayor's signature on the Ryan White HIV/AIDS Program Part A Estimated Unobligated Balance Report.
Amendment No. 7 to DCF Unified Homeless Grant Contract to increase the grant award amount.
Subrecipient Agreement with The Salvation Army in Emergency Solutions Grant programs funds to provide emergency shelter to families with minor children experiencing homelessness.
Amendment No. 1 to the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program Vendor Agreement with FP&L, and with City of Lake Worth Beach Utilities.
Negotiated settlement for full satisfaction of a code enforcement lien against Arlene J. Lynch.
Negotiated settlement for full satisfaction of a code enforcement lien against Andrew D. and Karyl J. Baxter.
Budget Transfer in the ARPA Response Replacement Projects Fund to modify project budgets of previously approve categories.

Second Amendment to the Interlocal Agreement with the City of Boca Raton to replace and update the substantial completion date for the construction of the 400' self-supported public safety radio communications tower.
Temporary Construction Easement in favor of South Florida Regional Transportation Authority to allow temporary use for a construction staging area.
Zero-dollar value Change Order No. 1 with Lebolo Construction Management, Inc. for the Jupiter Health Center Renovations project.
First Amendment with JFK Medical Center to extend the term of the Agreement for interoperable communications.
First Amendment with Jupiter Medical Center Inc. to extend the term of the Agreement for interoperable communications.
Change Order No. 5 with Lebolo Construction Management, Inc. for the C.L. Brumback Health Center Renovations project to increase the construction days.
Change Order No. 19 with Kast Construction Company LLC for the Supervisor of Elections Production Facility project.
Declaration of Easement in favor of Palm Beach County for water meter, a back flow preventer, a fire hydrant, and appurtenant equipment.
Standard License Agreement for Use of County-Owned property, and a First Amendment adjacent to the County Stockade and property located at 9620 Weisman Way.
License Agreement in favor of Hotwire Communications, Ltd. to use County-Owned property known as Roger Dean Stadium Sports Complex.
Impact Fee Affordable Housing Assistance Program funding award, and authorize the Mayor to execute a Certificate of Award.
Amendment 002 with the City of Greenacres extending the Agreement completion date.
Amendment 002 with the City of Lake Worth Beach to extend the performance timeline.
Consultant Services Authorization No. 7 with Mock, Roos & Associates, Inc. for Engineering Services for the East-West Water Main Interconnection Feasibility Study.
Contract with DMR Construction Services, Inc. for Western Region North Wastewater Treatment Facility.
Second Amendment with Seacoast Utility Authority to purchase and sale of Bulk Potable Water and Wastewater Service.

Interlocal Agreement with the City of West Palm Beach, East Center Regional Wasterwater Treatment Facilities Operation Board, and the Palm Beach County for Enhancement of the Reclaimed Water Facility; and Work Order NO. 3 with Globaltech, Inc. for design and construction of the enhancements/improvements.
Resolution authorizing Director of ERM to submit a grant application FWC Florida Boating Improvement Program grant for construction costs for the Old Bridge Park Dock Replacement project.
Entertainment Contractor Agreement with Frank LoVerso for the Whitestone concert.
Special Events Rental Agreement with Lights 4 Hope, Inc. for the Lights 4 Hope Event.
Agreement with Palm Beach County Food Bank, Inc. to provide Weekend Meal Program to children.
Appointment of one new member to the Criminal Justice Commission.
Agreements with Public Safety Answering Point locations for the installation, operation and maintenance of the 9-1-1 emergency call handling system.

Memorandum of Agreement with Palm Beach State College to formalize the coordination efforts for the delivery of forensic exams and services when responding to student and employee victims of sexual assault.
First Amendment with Diagnostic Centers of America, LLP for the provision of certain medical services.
Memorandum of Understanding with FLHSMV for Driver's License and/or Motor Vehicle Record Data Exchange.
Renewal of the excess property, excess liability, excess workers' compensation insurance programs and ancillary policies with Risk Management Associates, Inc.
Budget Transfer from LETF for PBSO's support of various programs for its strong commitment to the prevention and reduction of crime throughout Palm Beach County.
Tax Equity & Fiscal Responsibility Act Public Hearing concerning issuance in County Industrial Development Revenue Bonds, and adopt a Resolution.
Adopt an Ordinance as amended to the Surplus Property Ordinance.
Approve a Resolution approving Fiscal Year 2024 Mid-Year Budget Amendments and Transfers.
Adopt an Ordinance modifying the definition of the current gross annual revenue size standards for small businesses.
Adopt a Resolution providing for a referendum to determine whether the Board may grant economic development ad valorem tax exemptions to new businesses and expansions of existing buisnesses.
Rescind the American Rescue Plan Act Response Replacement Fund award to Vita Nova, Inc.; approve HOME American Rescue Plan Program, and direct staff.
Approve two ad-valorem funded positions for HED to assist with the administration of housing programs.
2023 Crime Statistics Report for the Palm Beach County Urban High-Crime Job Tax Credit Program.
Adopt a Resolution approving revisions to the Investment Policy.
Second Amendment with Connemara Associations, Inc. extending the term of agreement.
Interlocal Agreement with the Town of Hypoluxo for the purchase of land located at 7200 S. Federal Highway.
Request from staff for direction regarding the potential disposition of the County-Owned property located at 429 Park Place.
Request from staff for direction regarding the master planning of the 45 th Street Complex.
Appointment of two (2) members to the Zoning Commission.
Commissioner District Board Appointments.

source_note: Items and titles transcribed from the official agenda (table of contents or order of business). Agendas list what was scheduled, not what was decided; votes are not in agendas.
item_details_note: districts and named come from the item text in the agenda body (district tag at the end of each item; commissioners named with their title). Automated extraction; see the agenda PDF.
